newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average gains more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average gains more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rose more than 50 points in afternoon trading Monday, putting the blue-chip index solidly above its record closing high set in mid-March.

At 2:50 p.m, EDT, the Dow was up 50.17 points at 7,121.31, surpassing its record close of 7,085.16 set on March 11. The New York Stock Exchange's limit on program trading were activated after the Dow gained 50 points.
